headline: Your website is stable and fully monitored.
summary: In April we set up round the clock uptime checks, blocked 14 spam enquiries, refreshed the sitemap and tested a full restore.
improvementsNote: The main changes this month, each tied to an area of ongoing care.

improvements.title: Uptime checked every five minutes
improvements.body: The site is now checked around the clock, with an alert if it ever goes down.

improvements.title: Spam filter tightened on the form
improvements.body: Automated spam no longer reaches your inbox. 14 junk enquiries were stopped.

improvements.title: Sitemap refreshed for Google
improvements.body: Google now has an up to date list of every page on the site.

improvements.title: Full restore tested
improvements.body: We restored a complete copy of the site to confirm the backups work.
